observations: Small single-door refrigerator with a brown wood-grain finish.
A circular sticker on the top right of the door reads 'GREEN LIFE'.
The unit is sitting on top of a white refrigerator which has a 'SHARP VISION' badge.
The interior is empty, showing a wire shelf and a door shelf.
The door seal and edges show significant wear and scuffing.
The interior walls appear to be a light cream or beige color.
The unit is photographed in a warehouse or shop setting with other appliances.

claims.evidence: The exterior shows significant scuffing and wear on the door and seal, contradicting 'clean'.

risks.risk: The refrigerator may not be functional or may have poor cooling performance.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit powered on with the compressor running and a thermometer inside showing a drop in temperature.

risks.risk: The interior may have rust, mold, or odors not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video of the interior with the door open, showing the condition of the walls and shelves.

risks.risk: The door gasket may be torn or leaking, which is common in used units.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the door seal under the door.
risks.if_unproven: as having a leaking door seal

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the refrigerator plugged in and running with the compressor audible.
Video of the interior with the door open, showing the condition of the walls and shelves.
Close-up photo of the door gasket.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
